title: Film your matches
subtitle: A well-placed camera beats an expensive one. Where to stand, how to bring the video into Ndamba, and the gear that really helps.

now.hint: On a phone, the button opens the camera. The video stays on the device and opens in the studio.
now.title: Match filmed on {{date}}

spot.title: Where to put the camera
spot.lead: Up high, level with the halfway line, the whole pitch in frame. That is what lets you read the lines, the spaces and the positions.

height.title: As high as you can
height.body: 3 to 6 metres: a stand, a roof, a tall tripod. From above, you can read the lines and the spaces between players.

halfway.title: Level with the halfway line
halfway.body: A few metres back from the touchline, with the sun behind you if you can. Both halves are then filmed the same way.

whole.title: The whole pitch, no zoom
whole.body: Frame both goals, then leave it alone. You want to see all 22 players, not just the ball.

landscape.title: Landscape
landscape.body: Phone on its side, rotation locked, lens wiped before kick-off.

battery.title: Battery and airplane mode
battery.body: A power bank plugged in for the whole match, and airplane mode so a call cannot stop the recording.

storage.title: Free space, and 720p is enough
storage.body: Keep at least 10 GB free for 90 minutes. 720p gives lighter files and the analysis reads it very well.

ways.title: Bring the video into Ndamba
ways.lead: Three ways, depending on where you want the video to live. The first two are free.

link.title: A YouTube or Facebook link
link.body: On YouTube, publish as "unlisted"; on Facebook, the video must be public. Ndamba stores nothing and the video plays anywhere.

file.title: A file on the device
file.body: The file stays on the phone or computer, nothing is sent. You will need to open it again on each visit.

hosted.title: Upload to Ndamba
hosted.body: Match pass at {{pass}}, or Club video at {{club}} a month. The video plays anywhere without reopening a file, the AI can read it, and players and parents can watch it.

gear.title: The gear
gear.lead: Honest recommendations, to film from up high without interruptions. Always check the product page before buying.

veo.label: To go further
veo.title: Veo Go
veo.body: A rig that turns two iPhones into a panoramic match camera: the two images are stitched together to show the whole pitch in one shot.
veo.phones: You need two iPhone 11 or newer with an ultra-wide camera (not the iPhone SE or the iPhone 16e).
veo.subscription: It needs Veo's own subscription, on top of Ndamba.
veo.notAffiliated: Ndamba is not affiliated with Veo.

tripod.title: Tall sports tripod (20 ft)
tripod.why: Lifts the camera above everyone's heads, even without a stand.
tripod.check: The real height once extended, the load it holds, and how steady it stays in the wind.

mount.title: Phone tripod mount
mount.why: Holds the phone in landscape on any tripod.
mount.check: Firm grip, a head you can angle, and the standard 1/4 inch thread.

power.title: Power bank
power.why: Ninety minutes of video drain a phone fast.
power.check: At least 10,000 mAh and a cable long enough to reach the phone.

weight.title: Tripod weight bag
weight.why: Filled with water or sand on site, it steadies a tall tripod against the wind.
weight.check: That it empties and folds for transport, and hooks under the centre of the tripod.

disclosure: As an Amazon Associate, Ndamba earns from qualifying purchases.
noPrices: Prices, reviews and availability are the ones Amazon shows when you visit.
